registry.name: PredictionRMSE
registry.note: Root-mean-square per-tick prediction error over the whole run.

registry.name: HeldOutPredictiveLogLikelihood
registry.note: Requires a held-out split and a probabilistic predictor; the C7 core emits point predictions only. Not measurable in R1.

registry.name: RareEventRecall
registry.note: Requires exposed ground-truth rare-event labels; the Dataset contract deliberately hides ground truth. Not measurable in R1.

registry.name: KnowledgeRetentionScore
registry.note: Requires a re-test of earlier-learned regimes after later learning (a retention protocol not present). Not measurable in R1.

registry.name: GeneralizationScore
registry.note: Requires an unseen-but-related evaluation distribution. Not measurable in R1.

registry.name: TransferScore
registry.note: Requires a distinct downstream task to transfer to. Not measurable in R1.

registry.name: FinalEnergy
registry.note: Run-level cognitive free-energy proxy E=lam*H+mu*S_mean+nu*A at end of run. NOTE: FreeEnergyPolicy optimizes a closely related quantity by construction, so a FreeEnergy advantage here is partly definitional — see report 'Threats to Validity'.

registry.name: ReplayEfficiency
registry.note: Committed merges as a percentage of replay evaluations.

registry.name: AverageReplayCost
registry.note: Mean replay-window size per proposal evaluation.

registry.name: ClusterCount
registry.note: Live clusters at end of run.

registry.name: Entropy
registry.note: Conditional transition entropy of the final cluster chain.

registry.name: ActiveLoad
registry.note: Structural load at end of run.

registry.name: Runtime
registry.note: Wall-clock duration of the run loop.

registry.name: MemoryUsage
registry.note: Peak Python heap during the run (tracemalloc).

registry.name: ReplayDuration
registry.note: Cumulative time spent in read-only replay rehearsals.

registry.name: MergeCount
registry.note: Total merges committed to the live engine.

registry.name: ArtifactSize
registry.note: On-disk size of this experiment's artifact directory (populated post-write; may be null in the live metrics record).
